owner: ZOKUZOKU / ぞくぞく, indie developer of the Cat Gatekeeper browser extension and desktop app (@konekone2026)
story: The star of Cat Gatekeeper, a free browser extension by Japanese developer ZOKUZOKU (@konekone2026). Spend too long on social media and a giant, chubby orange tabby strolls onto your screen, plops down in front of your feed and stays until the break timer runs out. At launch there was no way to shoo it away; a later update lets you dismiss it early by pressing and holding a button for about three seconds. The launch post on 26 Apr 2026 ("I made a kitty forced-break app! Use social media too much and the kitty appears and takes over your screen") went viral on X, and Dexerto covered it the same day. Digital Trends and Popular Science wrote about it soon after. The official site now reports over 300,000 users, plus a Firefox version and a desktop app. The cat has no official name; the creator just calls it "kitty" (猫ちゃん). The site says its cats are "ideal cats created with the help of AI".
look: A photo-realistic (AI-assisted) giant, very chubby orange/ginger mackerel tabby. Darker orange stripes run across the forehead, cheeks, flanks and legs. The chin, chest, belly and paws are white. Amber/olive-gold eyes, often sleepily half-closed, and a pink nose. It wears a dark grey collar with a small silver bell. A huge round belly: it slumps back on one hip with its belly out and a hind leg stretched forward,, filling the screen in front of the social feed.

owner: Matt Taghioff (London), who runs @CuriousZelda
story: Zelda was a black-and-white London rescue cat. Matt Taghioff adopted her from the Mayhew rescue shelter in 2014; at first she hid under the sofa, watching him with an unblinking stare and spooking at the slightest noise. As @CuriousZelda ('Hunter of house flies and keeper of string. Easily startled. Often caught staring. Author of book.') she won fans with her startled look and her rhyming posts, such as her 2023 rhyme 'Will Twitter be toast? / Has everyone fled? / It's high time I shared / A Thread about bread'. With more than 80,000 followers she won a book deal at auction: 'The Adventures of a Curious Cat' (Sphere, an imprint of Little, Brown, 2019). Zelda died peacefully at home in 2024. Matt's farewell post thanked fans for their poems, memes and fan art.
look: A black-and-white tuxedo cat. Her head, back, legs and tail are solid glossy black, with a neat white bib from throat to chest, white front paws and white toes on the hind feet. Huge round yellow-green eyes with big dark pupils give her a permanently startled, wide-eyed stare. Black nose, long white whiskers, upright black ears and a compact, loaf-shaped build; sometimes a tiny pink tongue blep. No accessories.

owner: Donguri Mama (どんぐりママ, @nuts_mom_), who writes all his posts and wrote his KADOKAWA photo essay
story: Donguri is a male Munchkin born on 27 November 2020. He is famous for his 'paya-ke', the fluffy fuzz that kittens usually lose; his is still there well past his first birthday. Donguri Mama knew he was the one the moment she held him: he was lively for a kitten, and she couldn't resist how hard he tried to wriggle out of her arms. She named him Donguri ('acorn') because the colours and pattern round his face looked like a squirrel's, and a squirrel's favourite food is the acorn; his head is as round as one too (Joshi SPA!). A photo captioned 'rain is mysterious' went viral on Twitter and made him a star, and in April 2022 KADOKAWA published his photo essay 'Paya-ke no Donguri'. A back-of-the-head photo captioned 'Breakfast, please' drew 77,000 likes. Mama writes all his posts, including a running 'Paya-ke status today' series ('meditating', 'maximum wind speed').
look: Brown mackerel tabby Munchkin with dense black stripes. The forehead stripes run back over a very round, acorn-shaped head, and the fur behind the ears and on the cheeks is warm ginger-brown. Wispy kitten fuzz ('paya-ke') stands up on the crown and around the body. Big round dark eyes, a brick-pink nose with a dark rim, a white chin and upper chest, short striped legs, a plump 6 kg body and a thick ringed tail.

owner: Umi Sakurai (桜井海, @sakurai_umi_), creator of the manga A Man and His Cat (おじさまと猫)
story: Fukumaru (ふくまる) is the star of A Man and His Cat (おじさまと猫) by Umi Sakurai. The first chapter, posted on Twitter on 12 Jun 2017, opens with him saying 'I am a cat. I'm almost one, but I have no name yet': an Exotic Shorthair in a pet-shop window, his price cut from ¥320,000 to ¥90,000 while shoppers call him not cute. Wikipedia: he is a chubby black-and-white male, the runt of five siblings, passed over because customers found his flat face ugly, until an older man, Kanda, adopted him; he becomes a spoilt but kind indoor cat. Benesse: volume 1 came out from Square Enix on Cat Day, 22 Feb 2018. The series now has 17 volumes and a live-action drama (2021).
look: Drawn in soft greyscale pencil manga style. A huge, very round, chubby white Exotic Shorthair male with a flat face and black patches: a black cap-shaped patch on top of the head between the ears, a black spot on the muzzle beside the nose, a big round black spot on the chest, and black spots on the hip and at the base of the tail. Heavy-lidded, half-closed eyes, thick brows, a smug down-turned mouth, small ears set wide, and a loaf-like body with short legs.

owner: The anonymous owner who runs @ganymedeshouse, the cat's own account
story: Ganymede ("Gany") is a blind senior cat. His own X account, @ganymedeshouse, says "I am Ganymede. 16 or so. blind." His owner says his adoption papers estimated his age at about 8 in Sep 2018. In Oct 2021 the account posted two photos "of me (Ganymede - the cat)". One was the shot of him staring through a clear bottle, which makes his face look low-resolution. That photo spread as a meme, and Dexerto credits YouTuber MatPat with helping blow up his fame. On 17 Mar 2026 the owner pinned the originals: "My sister says his memes are everywhere on tik tok so im pinning the original photos here. My cat. I took these." The owner asks that Gany be used only in wholesome memes.
look: A cream-and-white shorthair. Pale cream/light ginger covers the top of his head, his ears and his back. His muzzle, cheeks, chin and chest are white, and his nose and inner ears are pink. His big round eyes look dark, with wide pupils; the owner says they look oddly reflective because of the condition that made him blind. His face is broad and slightly flat, with ears set wide and a little back. The meme shot shows him sitting behind a clear glass bottle, which blurs and pixelates his face; in close-ups he has a wide-eyed, startled stare.

owner: Andrew McCarthy (@AJamesMcCarthy), astrophotographer based in Arizona
story: Astrophotographer Andrew McCarthy adopted Gregory from an animal shelter in Sep 2024. His post said he took home "the cat with the saddest eyes at the shelter" (20.6M views). A day later he posted: "Sad eyes are gone." On the first anniversary McCarthy wrote that Gregory had been the oldest cat and the longest resident, and is now "a sassy, talkative friend who sits with me while I take photos of space." He photographed Gregory against his space images for the Cosmic Gregory 2026 calendar: basking under the Sun, toying with Saturn and 'representing the solar system' (PetaPixel). He shared the proceeds with the shelter, and on 5 Nov 2025 he donated $10k to Gregory's former shelter. On 5 Sep 2026 he announced that the Cosmic Gregory calendar returns for 2027, with Gregory meeting 'other life forms': fans' cats.
look: A fluffy long-haired orange (ginger) tabby male with a thick cream-white ruff and bib. Darker ginger tabby stripes run across his forehead and cheeks. His muzzle and chin are cream-white and his nose is pink. His amber-gold eyes looked droopy and sad in the shelter carrier photo. His ears are tufted with long pale furnishings, and he has long white whiskers, a plumed tail and a sturdy, heavily furred build. Later photos show a dark collar. PetaPixel (Oct 2025) quotes the vet's estimate that he is 4-5 years old.

story: Maruo (まるお) is the male Scottish Fold of Japanese YouTuber HIKAKIN, born on 25 May 2018 and living with him since 19 July 2018. Japanese Wikipedia says he was named for his round face and for being a boy. That September HIKAKIN also took in Mofuko (もふこ), Maruo's sister born the same day, so the separated siblings could live together again (youtube-walker). His one-photo post '本日のまるお🐈 冬の毛になってきた✨' ('Today's Maruo, his winter coat is coming in', October 2023) reached 101,043 likes and 20.3 million views. For the pair's 7th birthday in May 2025, HIKAKIN built them a giant cardboard castle.
look: An orange-and-white (red bicolour) Scottish Fold with a round, full-cheeked face. His small ears fold forward and lie flat against his head. His head, cheeks and back are orange with soft darker orange tabby stripes on the forehead and cheeks. A white blaze runs from the forehead down between the eyes to a white muzzle. His chin, chest and front legs and paws are white. He has large round amber-gold eyes and a pink nose, a stocky, rounded build, and a dense plush coat that thickens in winter. No collar. His sister Mofuko is also an orange Scottish Fold, named for being very fluffy.

owner: Hidekichi Matsumoto (松本ひで吉, @hidekiccan), manga artist, With a Dog AND a Cat, Every Day is Fun
story: Neko-sama ('Lord Cat') was the real cat of manga artist Hidekichi Matsumoto and co-star of With a Dog AND a Cat, Every Day is Fun, which began on her Twitter in February 2017. The first comic (5 Feb 2017) set the joke: the angelic dog hopes for snacks, while the cat, drawn with a deliberately fearsome glare, scoffs at him and raids the food after everyone is asleep. Kodansha (July 2019): her followers grew from about 3,000 to about 330,000, the first print run of 37,000 sold out on day one, and the cumulative print run had passed 500,000; a TV anime aired Oct 2020 to Mar 2021. Neko-sama and the dog Inu-kun were close like brothers; both lived to 13, and the artist said goodbye to the cat in February 2023.
look: Real cat, drawn in loose ink manga style. A stout white cat with dark grey-black patches: two dark patches on top of the head between the ears like a split cap, a dark smudge over the nose and muzzle, a dark spot on the back or saddle and one on the hip, and a dark tail with faint bands. Narrow, heavy-lidded glaring eyes (Kodansha's editor says the artist drew him with an impossibly frightening face), small ears, and a round loaf-like body. The real photo inset in the first comic shows a white cat with a black smudge across the nose and light eyes.

owner: Ricky Gervais (comedian) and his partner Jane Fallon (author)
story: Ollie was Ricky Gervais's Siamese cat. His friend Jonathan Ross gave her to him as a surprise when Ricky appeared on Ross's TV show in 2003, and she was named after Ricky's comedy hero Oliver Hardy (NZ Herald). She had her own Twitter account, @myleftfang, whose bio shouts 'ME ME ME ME ME ... TELL ME I'M A GOOD GIRL!'. When Ricky posted 'Just had to say goodbye to the sweetest little soul I've ever known. RIP Ollie July 9th 2003 - March 10th 2020', fans rushed to Twitter with condolences and Ollie trended on the platform (Radio X). Jane Fallon called her a 'smart, funny, feisty, beautiful sidekick'. Her account lives on: in October 2020 it posted 'I APPROVE!!! LOOK AFTER MY MUM PICKLE!' and on 9 July 2021, 'TODAY WOULD HAVE BEEN MY 18TH BIRTHDAY!!!'.
look: Seal-point Siamese. Her body is pale cream to ivory, and her points are a very dark seal brown: a full face mask covering the whole face, large upright pointed ears and a long dark tail. Her front legs are shaded a lighter fawn-brown. There is a small white fleck on the bridge of her nose between the eyes, and her eyes are blue. In her 18th-birthday photo she is mid-yowl with her mouth wide open and fangs showing, which fits her handle 'myleftfang'. No collar or accessories.

owner: Tsuyoshi Konoike (鴻池剛), manga diarist (@TsuyoshiWood)
story: Ponta (ぽんた) is the real male mixed-breed cat of manga diarist Tsuyoshi Konoike (@TsuyoshiWood). He stars in the one-page diary comics that made Konoike's following explode on Twitter. A friend found him as an abandoned kitten and pushed Konoike to take him, and his old name 'Nonta' became Ponta. He won't warm to strangers at all and scratches his owner often. His housemate Alfred, found hurt in the bushes behind the house, is gentle. The comics became the book series 鴻池剛と猫のぽんた ニャアアアン! (Kadokawa/Enterbrain, vol. 1 Oct 2015, vol. 4 Feb 2026) and two LINE sticker sets. Konoike's site marked Ponta's 14th birthday on 15 Sep 2025. In a 26 Aug 2026 comic his vet marvels that he gained 100 g and still runs and jumps despite long-term kidney disease, and then, held by the nurses for an ear cleaning, Ponta lands a swat on a hand.
look: As drawn in Konoike's bold, clean manga style with flat colour: a big, round, heavy-set, thick-furred cat. His back, head and tail are a warm caramel-brown. A white blaze runs down the middle of the face and widens into a white muzzle, and his chest, belly and paws are white. Small rounded ears and narrow, half-lidded glaring eyes give him a permanently grumpy, unimpressed face. In the 2023 surgery comics he wears a pink cone collar. Konoike says the real cat (a brown tabby-and-white) looks quite different from the simplified drawing, so follow the comic design.

owner: Helen Bevan, Robb Corrigan and family (live near the University of Warwick campus)
story: Rolf is the University of Warwick's campus cat; Wikipedia's Warwick article says the university 'has a campus cat named Rolf'. He lives with his family (Helen Bevan, Robb Corrigan and family) near campus and calls himself an 'Ambassacat for student health & wellbeing', with #RelaxWithRolf on Fridays. His X account was set up to track his movements across campus and tell students where to find him for a quick meet-up (The Boar). On 7 March 2021 hackers took over the account and replaced his daily updates with posts including a protest about bitcoin. The #CatsOfTwitter community let fans know he was safe, and Twitter support returned the account that Sunday night. Students have called for him to get an honorary degree. His daily 'Rolf report' still runs: posing with his staff ID card for the Exam Team, or being carried round the uni by his 'American Human' with all four paws dangling.
look: Sleek solid-black short-haired cat with golden-amber eyes, upright pointed ears and a slim, long body (he calls himself 'quite a long cat'); black paws. He wears a yellow reflective collar, and on duty a yellow hi-vis vest printed 'CAMPUS CAT'; his humans hold up his small staff ID card, which has his photo on it.

story: Takeru is a male Munchkin born on 21 March 2021. His family posts him on X as @takeru0321neko and on the YouTube channel まつもとたける, which shares 'the daily life of our cat Takeru and our family'. On 14 November 2021 they posted a staring, straight-on photo of him captioned 証明写真みたいなの撮れたね ('managed to take something like an ID photo'). Know Your Meme records this photo as the source of the Alien Cat meme. From early 2022 it spread as a reaction image on Twitter, Reddit and Tumblr. Edits followed through 2022: one removed his ears, another removed his nose and gave him completely black eyes like a grey alien, and from late June 2022 a version with even larger alien eyes circulated. In November 2023 the family asked X to explain the meme ('it's singing something, right?'). His bio now calls him the real identity of the singing-cat meme.

A solid black patch covers the crown of his head and runs into the back of his left ear (the viewer's right); his right ear is white with pink inside. His eyes are very large and perfectly round, usually with wide dark pupils inside a thin amber-green ring. He has a small pink nose, long white whiskers and a fluffy white chest. The meme photo is a symmetrical, straight-on staring head-and-chest shot against a pink curtain.

owner: Tsai Ing-wen (former President of Taiwan, @iingwen)
story: Think Think (蔡想想) is the grey tabby of Tsai Ing-wen, former President of Taiwan. In August 2012 legislator Hsiao Bi-khim found her near Heping Station in Hualien while inspecting damage from Typhoon Saola. Worried the kitten would be run over by relief machinery, she brought her to Tsai's Taipei office, where the thin, muddy kitten promptly peed. Tsai adopted her and named her after the Thinking Taiwan foundation she was setting up. With the ginger tabby Ah Tsai, a farm cat from near a Taitung pineapple field, she starred on campaign souvenirs, and she often joined Tsai when receiving guests. On X, Tsai introduced Philippine Senator Risa Hontiveros to 'my cat Think Think' (May 2023).

Bold charcoal-black mackerel stripes run over a warm silver-grey coat, with the classic tabby 'M' on the forehead, dark stripes on the cheeks and dark rings around the legs and a long tail. Her chest and belly are cream-white. She has large yellow-green eyes, a brick-pink nose and upright ears. In the 2023 photo she wears a small teal tag at her throat.

owner: Keir Starmer (former UK Prime Minister) and family
story: Prince is the Starmer family's white, blue-eyed Siberian kitten. Instead of the German Shepherd dog the family had talked about during the 2024 election campaign, they agreed on a kitten after 'a long summer of negotiations'. He moved into 10 Downing Street in early September 2024 as the third cat there, alongside the Starmers' rescue cat JoJo and Chief Mouser Larry (BBC). Keir Starmer revealed his name on the BBC's Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg (Independent). The first photo, by Simon Dawson/No 10 Downing Street, shows Prince with his paws on the PM's paperwork (BBC Newsround). Sun on Sunday political editor Kate Ferguson posted it on X on 21 Sep 2024 ('No update yet on how Larry is taking it') and it passed 2.2M views. The parody Larry the Cat account answered: 'My position as best looking cat on Downing Street remains unchallenged'.
look: A fluffy long-haired Siberian kitten, a few months old in the photo, small and round-bodied. The coat is cream-white overall, with faint warm buff/peach shading on the backs of the ears, the forehead and the cheeks (a hint of pale points). Pale pink inner ears with long ear tufts, round blue eyes and a small pink nose. A thick ruff on the chest, bushy fur down the legs, white paws, and a slightly startled stare. He stands on a red leather folder on the PM's desk. Refs: refs/prince_kf_GYB1nNOWAAAQF26.jpg (full official photo), refs/prince_kf_crop.jpg (close-up).
